Zoranth, The Forgotten One is the fifth boss you will encounter in your journey
Lore of Zoranth, The Forgotten One

"Once an explorer among the Ancient Builders, Zoranth was sent after the Armageddon War to the Nether, a land still scarcely unexplored at that time despite the power of his people. His mission was to find the villagers who had been condemned to wander in this dimension, forced to become piglins or other creatures. Unfortunately, Zoranth and his troupe did not escape this fate. After a few years, the portal closed, likely deliberately. It took only a few days for Zoranth's troupe to transform... Yet, he managed to evade this fate, consumed instead by the rage of betrayal and a desire for revenge, though unbeknownst to him, his people had already perished..."
You can summon Zoranth, by using an item called the Fiery Wither skull.
Current Crafting Recipe for the Zoranth Summon Item

Defeating it rewards you with three special items and unlocks the ability to mine ancient debris and unlocks netherite tools and armour, as well as a wide array of weapons. For a full list of weapons and armor see Weapon Progression and Armor Progression.
